id: -3100-荷爾-阿哈發動的努比亞戰役
theater: 第一瀑布阿斯旺上下游

battle.name: 荷爾-阿哈發動的努比亞戰役
battle.theater: 第一瀑布阿斯旺上下游
battle.brief: 約公元前3100年，荷爾-阿哈即位不久，遣隊沿尼羅河南下，穿越第一瀑布，深入瀑布以南的努比亞河谷。埃及軍以步卒為主，銅矛頭縛於木杆的長矛是近戰骨幹，弓手列於兩翼配合，法老自任陣前破陣的尖兵。卡面這柄早王朝埃及長矛，是這場沒有戰報細節的南部遠征中，埃及士兵開路與近身搏鬥的標準兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 荷爾-阿哈發動的努比亞戰役，是埃及早王朝第一次以國家名義、越過第一瀑布向南推進的軍事行動，交戰的兩邊卻都不是成熟國家。埃及一方是剛由那爾邁完成南北統一的第一王朝：都城在孟斐斯與塞尼斯，國王同時握有上下埃及之王與荷魯斯之名，統治依靠王室直屬地、王室祭司團（其中包括荷爾-阿哈新設的塞伊斯城奈特女先知「森姆」之職）與各州名冊上的徵召。軍隊沒有常備建制，兵源以王室近衛、持旗人與各州徵召步兵為主，靠旗幟分隊、以標誌辨認部隊。努比亞一方是尼羅河第一瀑布以南的下努比亞「A組」人群，即後來被稱為庫斯圖爾文化的社群，沒有中央政權，也沒有大王或首都；他們沿河散居，靠漁獵、畜牧與銅器技術度日，村落之間既競爭又互援，沒有能力組織跨河的大軍。沙漠與紅海沿岸的遊群（王表中的伊爾提特、瓦瓦瓦特、沙伊）則夾在兩者之間，既與埃及商隊往來，也趁亂劫掠。整體而言，這是一場以「國家對部落聯盟」為結構的邊境遠征，而不是兩個平等國家之間的戰爭。
countriesEn: The Nubian campaign of Hor-Aha was the first military operation the Egyptian Early Dynastic state launched under state auspices beyond the First Cataract, yet neither side was a mature state. The Egyptian side was the First Dynasty, freshly unified by Narmer: its capitals lay at Memphis and Thinis, and the king held at once the titles of King of Upper and Lower Egypt and Horus, ruling through the royal domain, the temple establishment of the crown (including the office of the Sem, the prophet of the goddess Neith at Sais, which Hor-Aha himself created) and the levy rolls of the nomes. There was no standing army. The manpower was drawn from the royal bodyguard, the standard-bearers and the infantry levied by the provinces, and units were identified by their standards. The Nubian side was the A-Group population of Lower Nubia south of the First Cataract, the community later known as the Qustul culture. It had no central government, no great king and no capital. Its people lived strung out along the river, subsisting on fishing, hunting, herding and copper working; their villages competed with one another and also helped one another, and they were in no position to raise a great army across the river. Between the two sides lay the desert and Red Sea fringe peoples — the Irtjet, the Wawawat and the Shai of the annals — who traded with Egyptian caravans and took every chance to plunder. In structural terms this was a frontier expedition of a state against a tribal league, not a war between two equal powers.
people: 整場戰役只留下法老一人的名字。荷爾-阿哈（Hor-Aha，意為「戰鬥的荷魯斯」），曼涅托在《埃及史》中稱他為阿托提斯，是第一王朝第二王，承接那爾邁的江山；他登位的年代，考古學界一般放在公元前3100年前後，其名下的年表標籤至少見「阿哈元年」與「阿哈三年」兩塊，記錄他巡行奈特在塞伊斯、雙女神在布托的祭祀場所。他做過一件與本役直接相關的事：在阿拜多斯另立王室陵墓與十餘座王室子女的副墓，把王室的祭祀與墓葬重心從希拉孔波利斯搬到阿拜多斯——那正是他遠征努比亞的後方基地與紀功場所。他還抹去前任王傑的名字，並首設森姆（奈特女先知）之職，把北方與三角洲的祭祀納入王室控制。參與者方面，埃及方面是無法點名的徵召步兵、持旗人、弓手與船工；努比亞方面沒有留下任何領袖姓名，只在後世對邊疆方物的描述中留痕。今日我們所知的一次「戰役」，是由這些年表、象形文字、象島與下努比亞出土的埃及式陶器與工具、希拉孔波利斯的早王朝城牆共同拼出來的。
peopleEn: Only the pharaoh's own name survives from the campaign. Hor-Aha — Horus who fights — whom Manetho in the Aegyptiaca calls Athothis, was the second king of the First Dynasty and inherited the realm from Narmer. Egyptologists place his accession around 3100 BC, and of his regnal year labels at least two survive, Aha year 1 and Aha year 3, recording his visits to the shrine of Neith at Sais and to that of the Two Ladies at Buto. One act of his bears directly on the campaign: at Abydos he raised a new royal burial and a set of more than a dozen subsidiary tombs for royal children, moving the centre of royal cult and burial from Hierakonpolis to Abydos — the very place that served as the rear base and the trophy ground of his Nubian expedition. He also erased the name of his predecessor Djer, and founded for the first time the office of the Sem of Neith, drawing the temples of the north and of the delta under royal control. On the Egyptian side the participants are names we cannot give: levied infantry, standard-bearers, archers and boatmen. On the Nubian side no leader's name is preserved at all, only a trace in later descriptions of the peoples of the frontier. The 'battle' we know today has been assembled from these year labels, from hieroglyphic inscriptions, from Egyptian-style pottery and tools excavated at Elephantine and in Lower Nubia, and from the Early Dynastic walls of Hierakonpolis.
kits: 卡面這柄早王朝埃及長矛，是這支部隊最普通也最要緊的裝備：銅質或青銅矛頭，用植物纖維或皮條縛在木杆上，杆長大致等於持矛者身高加一臂，便於在密集隊形中平舉刺擊，也能當作短棍格擋。早王朝埃及的全部正規步兵都是矛兵，隊形一旦被拉開，矛兵便失去作用，因此矛陣就是整支部隊的骨架。與矛並列的還有：銅斧與石斧（尼羅河谷斧形）、擲棒、銅或石製箭頭的複合弓、木盾與皮盾，以及王本人手持的狼牙棒——那爾邁調色板與希拉孔波利斯出土的象牙圖像上，法老高舉棒擊敵的「擊殺姿態」正是這場遠征的象徵。特別要留意的是沒有戰車、沒有騎兵：馬匹直到青銅時代晚期才傳入埃及，在荷爾-阿哈的年代，埃及與努比亞的戰鬥全部由步兵與弓箭手完成，唯一的機動是尼羅河上的船。埃及人用蘆葦與紙草編的船載人載貨，亦靠驢子馱運；努比亞一方則是獨木舟、銅器、木矛與弓。銅料仰給東沙漠與西奈的礦區，與南方作戰同時進行。
kitsEn: The Early Dynastic Egyptian spear on the card is the commonest and most important piece of equipment in the column: a copper or early bronze point lashed with plant fibre or hide onto a wooden shaft, the shaft roughly the height of its bearer plus an outstretched arm, so that it could be levelled and thrust in close order and also used as a short staff to parry. All the regular Egyptian infantry of the Early Dynastic Period were spearmen; once a formation was pulled apart the spearmen lost their function, and the spear line was therefore the skeleton of the whole army. Alongside the spear the soldiers carried the copper and stone axe of the Nile Valley type, the throwing stick, the composite bow with copper or stone arrowheads, wooden and hide-covered shields, and in the king's own hands the pear-headed mace: the raised-mace smiting pose of the pharaoh on the Narmer Palette and on the ivory tusks from Hierakonpolis is the emblem of this very expedition. What is conspicuously absent matters as much: there were no chariots and no cavalry. Horses did not reach Egypt until the late Bronze Age, so in Hor-Aha's day every blow fought in Egypt and Nubia was struck by infantry and archers, and the only mobility was by boat on the Nile. Egyptians moved men and cargo in reed and papyrus craft and hauled with donkeys, the only draft animal available; the Nubians had dugout canoes, copper tools, wooden spears and bows. Copper, meanwhile, came from the mines of the Eastern Desert and Sinai, worked in parallel with the fighting in the south.
tactics: 這場遠征的戰術核心是「沿河推進、逐點奪取」，因為尼羅河是唯一能讓大隊人馬與物資移動的通道。船隊溯流而上，到第一瀑布的急流與花崗岩巨岩前，必須改為人力與馱畜分批搬過險段，再在下游重新裝船。步兵在登岸地點以矛為前鋒結密集方陣，持旗人居中，弓手列於兩翼與後方，法老率近衛自陣中突出。埃及的堡壘式樣在希拉孔波利斯留下實證：帶壁柱的圍牆與「鎬形」拐角見於早王朝遺址，同樣手法也見於象島。努比亞方面的戰術是「退而不散」：村落到河灣、島嶼背後與沙漠邊緣游擊，用弓與長矛在岸上襲擾，再用獨木舟沿側流切斷糧道，因為他們沒有能力在開闊地上與埃及矛陣正面對撞。全軍沒有任何可以快速調動的衝擊手段，速度取決於船與步行，節奏也取決於尼羅河的汛期與酷熱，因此遠征必須在一年中涼爽的一段裡推進。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of this expedition was advance by river and the taking of one point after another, because the Nile was the only route along which a body of men and its supplies could move. The flotilla pushed upstream, and where the First Cataract's rapids and granite boulders blocked the channel, the loads and the men had to be carried across the difficult stretch in stages by human effort and pack animals, then reloaded onto boats below. On landing, the infantry closed into a dense block with the spears at the front, the standard-bearers in the middle and the archers on the flanks and in the rear, while the king led his bodyguard out of the line. Egypt's fortification idiom is documented at Hierakonpolis: niched walls and battered corners are found in Early Dynastic remains, and the same technique appears on Elephantine. The Nubian tactic was to give ground without breaking up: villages pulled back behind river bends, island backs and the desert fringe, harassing from the bank with bows and long spears, then cutting the supply line with canoes in the side channels, for they could never stand in the open and trade blows with an Egyptian spear line in a set-piece fight. The army had no means of rapid shock at all; its speed was the speed of boats and feet, its rhythm was set by the inundation and the heat, and an expedition of this kind had to be pushed through during the cooler part of the year.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但每一項都有其出處。荷爾-阿哈的在位年，曼涅托記十三年，都靈王表則給二十一在位年，兩者相差近十年，反映第一王朝王表本身就存在爭議；存世的年表標籤只到「阿哈三年」，即他至少在位三年以上，遠征應發生在即位後的早段。距離方面，由孟斐斯溯尼羅河至第一瀑布約八百三十公里，再南至第二瀑布的瓦迪哈勒法約一百九十公里。象島南北長約六百公尺，島上要塞區不大，早王朝時期已有人居與祭祀建築。下努比亞的A組文化約在公元前3800年至2700年間，跨越本役前後，說明河谷對岸的社群在埃及人到來之前已經是既成聚落。希拉孔波利斯的早王朝帶壁柱圍牆約六十乘五十公尺，阿拜多斯王陵的子女副墓群則出土十座上下。傷亡與俘虜數字無從查證：這場戰役沒有留下任何戰報。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, but each has a source. Hor-Aha's reign is given as thirteen years by Manetho and as twenty-one regnal years by the Turin Canon, a discrepancy of nearly eight years that shows how contested the First Dynastic king lists themselves are; the surviving year labels reach only Aha year 3, which means he reigned at least three years, and the expedition must fall in the early part of his reign. As for distances: about 830 kilometres of river lead from Memphis up to the First Cataract, and a further 190 kilometres south to Wadi Halfa at the Second Cataract. Elephantine is about 600 metres long north to south; its fortified area is small, but it was already settled and had cult buildings in Early Dynastic times. The A-Group culture of Lower Nubia ran from roughly 3800 to 2700 BC, spanning the period before and after this campaign, which shows that the communities across the river were an established presence before the Egyptians arrived. The niched enclosure at Hierakonpolis measures about 60 by 50 metres, and the group of subsidiary royal children's tombs at Abydos has yielded on the order of ten. Casualty and prisoner figures cannot be verified: this campaign left no battle report of any kind.
cause: 打這場仗的直接理由有四層。第一，統一之後的埃及第一次需要替自己的南方邊界找一個明確的界線：第一瀑布是尼羅河從阿斯旺到海法拉之間唯一的天然關口，也是全境唯一的交通瓶頸，控制它就控制了上游的一切往來。第二，資源：南方出黃金、烏木、象牙、獸皮與魚獲，後來還有努比亞的人力被編入埃及軍隊；王室的開支、宮廷作坊與祭祀用度都靠這條線補上。第三，人心與神意：法老需要一次南方勝利來證明新王朝的正統，並把這場勝利刻在阿拜多斯的新墓上。第四，壓力：埃及勢力向第一瀑布推進時，下努比亞的漁獵社群也正沿河向上活動，劫掠邊境村莊、挑戰徵稅的船隊，兩股力量在狹窄的河道與岩岸上必然相撞。於是「先立界、再收貢」成為這場遠征的實際邏輯。
causeEn: There were four layers of immediate reason for the fighting. First, a unified Egypt needed for the first time to fix a definite southern limit: the First Cataract is the only natural choke point on the Nile between Aswan and the Halfa, and the only bottleneck of any kind in the whole river system; whoever holds it holds everything moving above it. Second, resources: the south yields gold, ebony, ivory, hides and fish, and later Nubian manpower was enrolled into the Egyptian army; the court's expenses, the workshops and the cults all drew on that line. Third, legitimacy and divine favour: the king needed a victory in the south to prove the new dynasty's right to rule and to have it carved on the new tomb at Abydos. Fourth, pressure: as Egyptian influence advanced to the cataract, the fishing and hunting communities of Lower Nubia were moving upriver in their own turn, raiding frontier villages and challenging the tribute boats, and two such currents had to collide in a narrow channel and a rocky shore. The working logic of the expedition was therefore: set the boundary first, then collect the tribute.
impact: 這場遠征的直接影響，是把埃及的國家邊界從「尼羅河谷」推到「尼羅河谷加上一道關口」，並在象島建立南方的行政與駐軍節點：島上的奈特神廟、以及後來隨之擴充的哨所與倉儲，使第一瀑布從自然屏障變成可防守的國境線，由此開啟了古王國系統性經營努比亞的傳統——斯尼夫魯的遠征、佩皮一世與佩皮二世的使團與征伐、第六王朝的哈爾胡夫遠征，直到中王朝在第二瀑布修築塞姆納、烏尼與布痕一系列要塞，可以說都沿著荷爾-阿哈這一次試探的路線展開。另一層影響在考古學與藝術上：這次戰役把「法老持棒擊敵」的形象固定為王權的標準語彙，並在阿拜多斯留下第一批王室副墓，使早期王朝的陵墓制度成形。誠然，我們也要承認這場戰役的直接文獻極為稀少，它的歷史位置更多是後世由考古拼湊出的結論。
impactEn: The direct effect of the expedition was to push Egypt's state frontier from 'the Nile valley' to 'the Nile valley plus a checkpoint', and to create an administrative and garrison node on Elephantine: the temple of Neith on the island, with the watch posts and storehouses that grew up alongside it, turned the cataract from a natural barrier into a defensible frontier line, and so opened the tradition of the Old Kingdom managing Nubia systematically — Sneferu's expeditions, the missions and campaigns of Pepi I and Pepi II, Harkhuf's expeditions in the Sixth Dynasty, and finally the chain of fortresses at Semna, Uronarti and Buhen along the Second Cataract in the Middle Kingdom can all be read as continuations of the line Hor-Aha probed. A second effect lies in archaeology and in art: the campaign fixed the image of the pharaoh smiting his enemies with the mace as the standard vocabulary of kingship, and left at Abydos the first set of royal subsidiary tombs, so that the funerary institution of the early dynasty took shape. It must also be admitted, however, that the direct literary record of this campaign is extremely thin; its place in history is largely a later reconstruction from archaeology.
result: 結局並非一場殲滅戰。埃及沒有能力也沒有企圖把下努比亞的社群連根拔除：那些社群沒有首都，沒有可佔領的城池，消滅他們等於消滅稅源與兵源。遠征的實際成果是劃界與設點——埃及的據線停在第一瀑布上下，象島與塞伊一帶出現固定的駐軍、廟宇與倉儲；越過關口的往來被編入秩序，越界的武裝被壓回河灣；南方來的黃金、象牙、烏木、獸皮，以及逐漸為人所知的南方人本身，成為王室帳目上的一條固定收入線。從武器的角度看，這場戰役確立了早王朝埃及「以矛為骨、以弓為輔、以船為路」的軍隊樣板，兩千年後的青銅時代埃及仍沿用同一套結構，只是把矛頭換成更長的青銅矛、把船換成更大更耐久的方形帆船。戰役本身沒有留下戰報，也沒有留下可查的傷亡與俘虜數字；能確定的是，第一道南方國界線，在荷爾-阿哈手裡第一次被寫進埃及的地圖上。
resultEn: The outcome was not a decisive annihilation. Egypt had neither the ability nor the intention to uproot the communities of Lower Nubia: they had no capital and no capturable cities, and destroying them would have meant destroying its own sources of tribute and soldiers. What the expedition actually delivered was delimitation and fixed points — the Egyptian line came to rest on either side of the First Cataract, permanent garrisons, temples and storehouses appeared around Elephantine and Sehel, traffic passing beyond the choke point was brought into order, and armed excursions were pushed back into the river bends; gold, ivory, ebony, hides from the south, and the southern people themselves as they became better known, settled into a fixed line on the crown's accounts. Seen from the weapon side, the campaign set the Early Dynastic Egyptian pattern of 'the spear as the skeleton, the bow in support, the boat as the road', and the same structure was still in use two thousand years later in the Bronze Age, with longer bronze heads on the spears and larger, sturdier square-sailed ships in place of the reed craft. The campaign left no battle report, and no casualty or prisoner figures can be checked; what is certain is that the first line of Egypt's southern frontier was, under Hor-Aha, written onto Egypt's map for the first time.
